transition_rules.outofstock: For a published product keep the URL by default, verify visible availability and schema, and do not infer discontinuation.
transition_rules.onbackorder: For a published product keep the URL and represent backorder accurately; never claim immediate stock.
transition_rules.nonpublic_product: Treat draft/pending/private products as internal lifecycle records; do not issue public keep-URL, redirect, or canonical actions.
transition_rules.discontinued_explicit: Require explicit evidence and a separate keep/replace/redirect/410 decision with readback.
transition_rules.stale_content: Queue substantive review only; do not write dateModified until the visible content materially changes.
transition_rules.status_transition: Review publication/indexing implications before any redirect, canonical, or deletion decision.
transition_rules.stock_transition: Recheck visible availability and structured-data parity; do not rewrite content merely to refresh the date.
transition_rules.duplicate_or_superseded: Require a canonical/redirect plan and post-write readback before deprecation.
transition_rules.governance_asset: Re-review when upstream evidence, routing, compatibility rules, or source validity materially changes.
